```dockerfile
# Stage 1: deps
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci

# Stage 2: build
FROM node:20-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
RUN npm run build          # tsc → dist/

# Stage 3: prod deps only
FROM node:20-alpine AS prod-deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev

# Stage 4: final
FROM node:20-alpine AS final
ENV NODE_ENV=production
WORKDIR /app

# Non-root user
RUN addgroup -S appgroup && adduser -S appuser -G appgroup
USER appuser

COPY --from=prod-deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build     /app/dist         ./dist
COPY package.json ./

EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## Why each stage

| Stage | Purpose | Dropped in final |
|-------|---------|-----------------|
| `deps` | Install all deps (cache layer) | Yes |
| `build` | Run `tsc` | Yes — src + devDeps gone |
| `prod-deps` | `npm ci --omit=dev` clean install | Yes |
| `final` | Runtime only | — |

## Size wins

- **alpine** base → ~180MB vs ~1GB full node
- **devDeps excluded** — no ts, @types/*, ts-node, etc.
- **Source excluded** — only `dist/` copied
- **Non-root user** — security + some registries require it

## Assumptions to adjust

```
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]   # change if entrypoint differ
EXPOSE 3000                      # match app port
npm run build                    # must call tsc, check package.json scripts
```

## `.dockerignore` — add this too

```
node_modules
dist
.git
*.md
.env*
```

Without `.dockerignore`, `COPY . .` send fat context → slow builds.
